scope: 实际参数消费位置，后续由编码和代表参数变化检查

environment_inputs.V5_EPISODE_ROOT: resolve and require exact equality with render.py parent episode root
environment_inputs.V5_EFFECTIVE_DEFAULTS: require this episode 00_brief/effective_defaults.json; read and hash before rendering; rehash before final rename
environment_inputs.V5_PRODUCTION_CONTRACT: require this episode 03_storyboard/production_contract.json; read and hash; validate fps and total_frames; rehash before final rename

effective_defaults.video.width: Chrome viewport width and ffprobe output width verification; require 1920
effective_defaults.video.height: Chrome viewport height and ffprobe output height verification; require 1080
effective_defaults.video.fps: episode/contract equality check; FFmpeg image pipe framerate, audio seek and duration, frame-count duration verification; require 30
effective_defaults.audio.preserve_provided_voice: require true; use only original voice, checked against episode voice SHA-256; no gain/speed/mixing filter
effective_defaults.tools_local.ffmpeg: actual FFmpeg executable and adjacent ffprobe
effective_defaults.type.regular_font: file existence preflight; actual browser font usage belongs to page renderer
effective_defaults.type.bold_font: file existence preflight; actual browser font usage belongs to page renderer

renderer.timeline: episode.json and production_contract.json must both declare 1678 frames at 30 fps; full output is 55.93333333333333 seconds, no -shortest
renderer.page_contract: local server rooted at episode; /06_project/index.html and app.js must exist; await window.ready Promise and window.renderFrame(absoluteFrame)
renderer.resource_failure_policy: abort on pageerror, console.error, HTTP >= 400, request failure, image decode failure, failed font face, external origin request
renderer.output_policy: inside episode only; refuse existing MP4 or partial; JPEG screenshot bytes streamed to FFmpeg stdin; atomic partial-to-final rename after ffprobe and input hash checks
renderer.machine_report: 08_qc/render_<timestamp>_<pid>.json binds effective-defaults, contract, voice and output hashes to consumed video parameters, FFmpeg command and ffprobe evidence
renderer.acceptance_limit: configuration/encoding/container checks do not establish illustration semantic correctness, card process quality or normal-speed subjective audiovisual acceptance

cards.scope: 8张信息卡的本地SVG渲染；字幕由主app消费独立字幕参数

actualConsumption.consumer: config.node -> 节点、字段、选项及CTA实际text font-size
config.support -> 必要说明、示意标识、辅助正文实际text font-size
节点/消息/标题的显式progress时长
C05消息与C07新词连续上移距离
C03层级线与首节点实际开始时刻
config纸白主题基础色；C01/C03/C04/C06实际填充、文字、边缘和关系线
C07实际背景、文字、强调及旧判断对比色
renderCard实际SVG clipPath限制语义主体

explicitLocalChoices.timing: 按SRT锚点逐卡安排，不使用固定节拍；duration只限定本卡有效时间，不把各卡过程等比例压缩
explicitLocalChoices.geometry: 1920×1080语义构图；所有固定坐标按本集内容设计。100单位图标路径保持100单位合同。
explicitLocalChoices.easing: 对象默认cubic_out；路径及协调变化用smoothstep连续进度，沿真实曲线弧长取位，未使用全局时钟或Tween.js
explicitLocalChoices.continuousMotion: 信息卡保留真实中间帧，不套插画单图2秒规则
explicitLocalChoices.captionSafe: [160,920,1760,1040]为主app独立字幕责任；cards.js不渲染字幕，不在该区放关键正文
explicitLocalChoices.titleAnchor: C01标题的中心、字号与textLength共享降级进度，保持最终左缘128且无锚点跳变
explicitLocalChoices.twoLargePanelPolicy: C04唯一双大面板使用defaults.cards.palette.dark与paper；其他卡按关系采用环盘、层级、聊天、单文档或四个小候选

fontExceptions.reason: 四条聊天同屏需保留历史；字号为node46减6，其余主要节点仍46、辅助34

explicitLocalChoices.sourceCopies: C01/C04/C05/C06保留可复用源，仅传副本；目标内容只在副本到达后建立

blue.reason: 概念分解与访谈采用轻量蓝纸，正文与辅助字同步使用深蓝灰对比色

peach.reason: 结尾开放选择采用暖纸；四项同等面积、没有赢家与默认选中

notClaimed.reason: 本实现阶段只检查源码语法和抽样调用；实际编码画面检查与正常速度审片由主代理按匹配输出另记。

composition.video_dimensions: render.py viewport/FFmpeg + app.js fit logical canvas
composition.fps_and_total_frames: render.py configuration validation + app.js renderFrame selection
composition.type.family: app.js caption font + cards.js config family
composition.layout.caption_safe: app.js fixed caption-region position and dimensions
composition.animation.max_static_seconds: locked validator verifies contract; app.js displays a complete still with no time-dependent transform
composition.layout.corner_labels_enabled: app.js/cards.js have no fixed corner-label renderer
